rationale: The agent verified the user appropriately using full name plus old ZIP and matched a single account via the tool. They requested the new address and stated they would confirm before making any changes, and they did not perform any write without explicit confirmation. When the user declined to share the new address, the agent correctly explained they could not proceed, which is in line with policy. The agent used product tools to identify the cheapest available T-shirt variant and reported accurate details ($46.66 for the red, size L, cotton v-neck). They also accurately stated they could not place a new order (no tool support) and advised using the website/app. No fabricated information or actions on the wrong account occurred. The only minor issue was implying the user might provide just city/state/ZIP, which could be ambiguous, but no update was made based on that. Overall compliant, though the address update was not completed due to missing user-provided details, so completion is partial.
